subject: Post-call recap + model fit recommendations / follow-up on regression concern
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model fit / evals)

Hi Alice / Bob —

Great speaking with you this morning. Quick recap and recommended next steps based on the discovery: 

- Problem: Acme wants a customer support summarization flow with entity extraction and sentiment scoring across historical tickets and chat logs. Key constraints: 99th-pctl latency < 400ms for short queries, PII handling, and regression sensitivity to model updates.
- What we showed: Redwood hosted endpoint for chat/generation, embeddings for search/semantic similarity, and our eval harness for regression detection.
- Recommended models to start with: Mistral-7B-v1 (quantized) for low-cost embeddings+generation baseline; Llama2-13B-instruct (fp16) for higher-fidelity extractions. Vivek attached benchmark excerpts.

Next steps: 
1) Vivek will share the prompt-set and the evaluation harness (we'll sync on the exact metrics to track: ROUGE, extraction F1, and a small human-eval for hallucination).
2) Acme to share a small representative prompt set (5-10 examples) and a sample of 500 anonymized tickets. We can run a quick quality baseline.
3) We (Redwood) will run A/B tests across the two model variants and provide a regression report; if a version update triggers a regression, we can pin to a known-good model binary and coordinate a rollback.

Attachments: redwood_benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf, acme_prompt_set_v1.csv (placeholder suggested).

Looking forward — is Wednesday 6/30 at 10am PT still good for the technical sync?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model fit / evals)

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. 6/30 10am PT works for us. We'll prepare a 500-ticket sample and the 10 prompts by EOD Tuesday.

A couple of questions up front: 
- For the model pinning / rollback, what SLA do you offer for rollback timelines if we hit a severe regression?
- On the PII side, we need to see audit logs and KMS integration details. Can Vivek include those in the tech sync?

Alice
Head of AI Product | Acme Corp

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model fit / evals)

Thanks all — quick notes from the technical sync: 

1) Benchmarks and model choices: attached excerpt (redwood_benchmarks_Q2_2026.pdf). For Acme's extraction-heavy workload, our baseline recommendation is: 
   - Candidate A: Mistral-7B-v1 (int8/ptq) — best cost/latency tradeoff for conversational extractive tasks.
   - Candidate B: Llama2-13B-instruct (fp16) — better on precision for structured extraction but ~1.8x cost.

2) Evaluation harness: I uploaded our prompt set template and a sample eval script. We'll run diff-based metrics comparing current "gold" model (Llama2-13B-instruct@2026-06-15) to new candidates. Regression detection will include per-example delta F1 and overall human-eval flags.

3) Security & compliance: Redwood Private supports KMS/HSM integrations and full audit logs. I'll share the SOC2 evidence pack after this thread.

4) Rollback & pinning: Operationally we can pin a customer to a specific model artifact id. Typical rollback SLA for hosted customers is 4 hours to pin and route traffic to the pinned variant, and 24-48 hours for deeper investigation and model patching. For Dedicated/Private we can achieve faster on-prem pinning as part of the support contract. See attached rollback_playbook_v1.docx for the playbook.

Links:
- Eval harness (internal): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345
- Benchmarks: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-benchmarks

I'll run the first pass of the evals on the sample you provide and post results here.

— Vivek
Senior ML Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 11:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model fit / evals)

Quick update from our test run: we ingested the 500-ticket sample and ran the baseline against Llama2-13B-instruct@2026-06-15 (gold). After the team updated to Llama2-13B-instruct@2026-06-30 we saw a 7.2 point drop in extraction F1 on our critical entity set and a significant increase in hallucination on negative examples. This is blocking our pilot.

We need an immediate plan: can Redwood pin us back to the 6/15 artifact and run a diff? We'd prefer a rollback until you can confirm the 6/30 variant's fixes. Please treat as high priority.

Thanks,
Bob Lee
Senior Data Scientist | Acme Corp

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme.com>, Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + recommended next steps (model fit / evals)

Bob / Alice —

I'm escalating this internally and we've flagged it high. Vivek — please prioritize: 1) pin Acme to Llama2-13B-instruct@2026-06-15 artifact immediately and confirm routing; 2) run the per-example diff and share a csv of failures; 3) if the fix is non-trivial, propose a rollback window and remediation plan.

Rishi / Laura — looping you in for SLA/credits discussion and to coordinate with our Support/CS teams. Laura, can you confirm whether we can meet the 4-hour pin SLA for this account (we're still in POC)?

I'll follow up with a short timeline once Vivek confirms the pin.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
